description: This file defines classes and objects related to user-defined functions (UDFs) in Apache Spark SQL, including the abstract class UserDefinedFunction, its implementation SparkUserDefinedFunction, and the aggregator UserDefinedAggregator.

classes.name: UserDefinedFunction
classes.description: An abstract class representing a user-defined function in Spark SQL, with methods to check nullability, determinism, and to invoke the function.

classes.name: SparkUserDefinedFunction
classes.description: A concrete implementation of UserDefinedFunction, encapsulating a Scala function, data type, encoders, and properties like nullability and determinism.

classes.name: UserDefinedAggregator
classes.description: A class representing a user-defined aggregation function in Spark SQL, extending UserDefinedFunction with an underlying aggregator and encoder.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a new SparkUserDefinedFunction from a Scala function and type tags.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a new SparkUserDefinedFunction from a function, input encoders, and output encoder.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a new SparkUserDefinedFunction from a function, return type, and cardinality.

methods.name: withName
methods.description: Sets a name for the user-defined function.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the UDF.
